summary: Answered the owner's 'focus on script, hook and topic' note: a Short now fails when the line after the hook is a wider total, a rescale, a baseline or a setup, and the strongest hook test is first in line for the next hook cycle. Retired the plum palette. Cycle 1 is still collecting data.
why: The auditor's channel review: in 20 of 26 Shorts the steepest fall is at 4.5-7 s, on the second line; its picture tally names plum the worst palette (16.4% vs 26.6% held after the hook). The evaluator has 0 of 8 Shorts a side for cycle 1, so no verdict tonight.

findings.title: Cycle 1 waits
findings.detail: real-subject-first-frame: 0 of 8 Shorts a side with two days of data, day 2 of 7 (on 2, off 0). Verdict due by 20 Nov.

findings.title: Long tests wait
findings.detail: quiet-bed 1 of 4 long videos a side, chart-gap-fill 2 of 4.

findings.title: What performs (48 h views vs median)
findings.detail: story money_scale 10.3x (n 7), hook challenge 3.1x (n 4) vs question 0.38x (n 15), length 20-24 s 4.6x (n 3), 30-34 s 2.9x (n 8).

findings.title: Impact, week of 9 Nov
findings.detail: 9 Shorts: median 84 views at 48 h (43 the week before), 71.8% viewed (51.2%), stayed to watch 0.311 (0.381), 19.1 s watched.

findings.title: Most widespread failures
findings.detail: QA edge cuts (29 videos), empty frames (29), recurring 'QA failed after three rounds' twice; edge cuts got a probe fix on 14 Nov, re-checked next run.

changes.title: The line after the hook carries on the story
